S01: Long ago, in the heart of the Earth, lay Irkalla — the dark kingdom of the dead.
S02: And above the Earth, up high, lived Ishtar — the beautiful and powerful goddess of love.
S03: Thoughts of her sister Ereshkigal gave her no peace, and she desired to descend to her at any cost.
S04: And so, the proud goddess left the sky and set out downward, toward the underworld.
S05: Before her rose the gate of the underworld — high as the sky, cold and forbidding.
S07: She stood before the gate and raised a hand to knock.
S08: Ishtar: "Open, or I shall break your gate!"
S09: On the other side, a frightened gatekeeper listened and trembled.
S10: He dared not argue — and opened the heavy gate.
S11: The gatekeeper led her through dark corridors, ever deeper into Irkalla.
S12: Deep in the kingdom awaited the throne hall of Ereshkigal.
S13: And upon the throne sat Ereshkigal herself — the dark queen of the dead.
S14: Ereshkigal: "If you are here, then who spreads love upon the Earth?"
S15: Ereshkigal: "You wished to visit my kingdom, and now you shall become my prisoner!"
S16: And so, the pride of Ishtar remained chained in the underworld.
S17: Her golden bracelets no longer shone as before.
S18: And above, on the Earth, something began to die.
S20: Men and women no longer fell in love with one another.
S21: The whole world fell silent in sorrow.
S22: Even the most beautiful flower withered and fell.
S23: Then a messenger of the people stepped forward.
S24: He set out on the road downward, to Irkalla, to plead for Ishtar.
S25: And he stood before the throne of Ereshkigal, small before the endless darkness.
S26: Messenger: "Spare Ishtar, my lady, for the Earth withers without her."
S27: Ereshkigal pondered — and in her eyes flashed a cold compassion.
S28: Ereshkigal: "Very well, I shall release her — but only if another takes her place."
S29: The condition was clear: someone must take her place.
S30: And then, for the first time in a long while, the chains of Ishtar fell.
S31: Free, Ishtar set out up the long stairs.
S32: And at last, she saw the sun again.
S33: The Earth began to live again.
S34: And the fruits ripened once more.
S35: Men and women looked upon one another with love again.
S36: The whole world sang again with joy.
S37: And Ishtar, free, set out toward her home.
S38: She climbed the stairs of the palace and entered.
S39: But at home awaited her something she did not expect.
S40: Tammuz, her husband, sat lost in himself — as if he had noticed nothing.
S41: He had not even perceived that she had been gone so long.
S42: And in Ishtar's breast, the emptiness turned to anger.
S43: Ishtar: "Here is the one who shall go in my place!"
S44: And in that very instant, the servants of Ereshkigal appeared from the shadows.
S45: They seized Tammuz and dragged him toward the gate of Irkalla.
S46: And led him downward, into the kingdom of the dead.
S47: Ishtar watched — and in the victory there was also a shadow of sorrow.
S48: And Ishtar, now free and safe, ruled over the Earth once more.
